topic: DataCorp data processing requirements and plan
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed receiving a data request from DataCorp. The core issue discussed was how to handle network information within the provided files, as DataCorp does not normalize file names.

It was determined that instead of embedding network details within a single file's name, the team will create two separate files for each network connection.
decisions: The data processing requires creating and running scripts to handle the data.
Two separate files will be generated for every network connection.
action_items: [me] will provide a new script with detailed instructions.
Someone needs to set up the job/job scheduling after the script is ready.
